title: vx run --dry=json
description: The task graph a run would execute and what the cache predicts for each task; nothing runs.

affectedBase.description: under --affected: the ref the diff was taken against (a bare --affected guesses it: origin/HEAD, a trunk branch, else HEAD~1)

cacheStatus.description: skipped: exec.platforms leave this machine out, or a task it depends on is skipped; the run skips it too

p50Ms.description: typical executed duration, when history has one

executor.description: where it would run; only when the workspace declares more than one executor

otherPlatform.description: a skipped task's own exec.platforms, and this machine's

blockedBy.description: a skipped task's root: the task off this machine's platforms it depends on

affected.description: why --affected kept this requested task; absent on a dependency it pulled in

kind.description: input: a changed file is a declared input; project: its project changed and the task reads it whole; workspace: a workspace-wide file (the workspace config, a root file a plugin claims) changed; package: a ^ edge passes a changed package; named: asked as pkg#task; selected: another filter selected its project

via.description: the dependsOn chain, nearest first, to the task the change reached

unknownCount.description: would-run tasks with no history; the times are lower bounds when above 0

criticalPath.description: the would-run task ids with history along the chain wallMs measures, dependencies first

downloadDowngrades.description: producers --cache-download wanted to defer but could not, and why
